text:
maya: Quick note 1:00 UTC tonight we're doing the dusk handoff for the model-surge rollout. Posting the minimal checklist and emergency-unpin rules. Please ack ASAP.

deploy-bot: Canary update: service=model-surge canary=10% since=20:40 UTC, health=degraded(2/3 hosts) recent_errors=0.4% :warning:

evan: Are we still locking unpins during the 23:00-03:00 UTC window?

maya: Yes. No unpins or hotfix merges except via emergency-unpin. Only two approvers (maya + evan) can authorize. Manual override logged is required.

ji-ho: What's the emergency-unpin criteria? Need short thresholds.

maya: Emergency-unpin criteria (any one triggers):
- p99 > 1500ms sustained for > 4m
- total error rate > 1% on 1m window
- token-cost anomaly > 30% vs baseline for > 5m
- canary host OOM / crashloop

evan: Noted. If triggered, call it here and run the quick rollback command.

maya: Quick ops checklist (minimal):
- deploy pin applied (pin the routing to the canary v2024.06.12)
- canary health dashboard open (ops link in runbook)
- rollback owners assigned (evan primary, ji-ho backup)
- smoke payloads loaded into canary (2 traffic shapes)
- deploy bot rollback command tested in staging

ji-ho: Pin status?

deploy-bot: Pin command executed: `/deploy pin service=model-surge version=v2024.06.12 reason="dusk-hand-off"` applied by maya at 20:47 UTC :round_pushpin:

evan: I'll be on watch for p99 and CPU across the canary ring. If we see the latency slope go up, I'll call rollback and run the commands below.

maya: Rollback quick commands (copy/paste):
```
/deploy rollback service=model-surge to=v2024.06.08 reason="emergency-unpin"
/deploy quarantine canary service=model-surge
```

oncall-bot: Oncall rota: evan (primary), ji-ho (secondary) for the 23:00-03:00 UTC window. Pager rules unchanged.

evan: Two small exceptions to lockdown: metric config tweaks (no code changes) allowed if they are revertable via UI and approved by both approvers.

ji-ho: Understood. I won't change configs unless both approvers thumbs-up.

maya: Release notes link: https://internal.redwood/releases/model-surge-2024-06-12 (contains perf bench, known regressions, mitigation steps).

evan: Quick smoke from deploy-bot just ran, results okay but p95 creeping - will monitor.
deploy-bot: Smoke run at 20:52 UTC: samples=200, avg=320ms, p95=850ms, p99=1120ms, errors=0.35% :white_check_mark:

maya: Heads-up about hotfix policy: during dusk handoff we allow a single emergency hotfix only if it is a one-line rollback or config flip and both approvers + oncall consent. Document the change in the safety-lift channel.

evan: Ack. If we need to escalate to an emergency unpin I'll post the thresholds crossed and run the rollback.

ji-ho: ack :eyes:

maya: ack :thumbsup:

maya: After 03:00 UTC we do a 15m stability check and then unlock the normal merge/unpin cadence. I'll post the post-handoff snapshot to the release doc.

deploy-bot: Lock engaged for unpins until 03:00 UTC. Manual override allowed by maya or evan only.
